## Summary

[Partial] Put the truck in 3rd gear to count RPM drops indicating smooth torque converter lockup. [t666]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Put the truck in 3rd gear.
2. [Partial] Count the number of RPM drops to see if they total three, indicating smooth torque converter lockup.

_Procedure reported by [t666]._

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Compare shifts with Overdrive engaged versus disengaged; OD should add a 5th gear shift and potentially engage the torque converter later. [t666]
- If three RPM drops occur in 3rd without slap, the lockup is functioning correctly. [t666]
